_meta.notes: C01 UI shell: layer stack, theme tokens, toast/panel defaults. C04 owns HUD element contents; C05 owns screens.

text_scale.notes: Global UI text scale applied as a CSS variable.

layers.notes: Z-index stack for DOM overlay layers. Higher layers always win.

theme.notes: Design tokens: the names a UI surface asks for, each pointing at a palette role. Plain colors only - no rarity tiers (RULE_20). The client resolves them against config/palette.json at boot and publishes them as --pl-theme-*; a colour value lives in the palette and nowhere else (A01).

toast_duration_ms.notes: Default time a toast notification stays visible.

toast_max_stack.notes: Maximum toasts stacked before older ones are dropped.

panel_default_width_px.notes: Default width for collapsible side panels.

reduced_motion.notes: Respect OS reduced-motion: kills camera shake, particles and sway.

safe_area_padding_px.notes: HUD padding from the device safe-area edge.

hud_update_interval_ms.notes: Minimum time between plant-status HUD text updates (DESIGN 18.2 caps HUD at 10 Hz).

damage_vignette_ms.notes: Length of the edge vignette shown when the plant takes damage.

health_healthy_fraction.notes: Structural fraction at or above which the plant reads Healthy.

health_stressed_fraction.notes: Structural fraction at or above which the plant reads Stressed.

health_withering_fraction.notes: Structural fraction at or above which the plant reads Withering; below it reads Dying.

display_name_max_length.notes: Longest accepted display name in characters. Enforced by the client form and by the server on HELLO.

title_parallax_enabled.notes: Pointer and drag parallax on the title screen. Off leaves a still scene.

title_parallax_drag_px.notes: How far the background may be dragged from centre, in CSS pixels, before it stops. Title screen only.

title_parallax_hover.notes: Share of the pointer offset the background follows when not dragging. Title screen only.

title_parallax_depth.notes: Per-layer parallax multipliers. Lower numbers move less, so distant art reads as distant.

title_parallax_settle_ms.notes: Spring-back time after a drag ends. Title screen only.

title_plant_sway_ms.notes: One full idle sway of the title plant, in milliseconds.

title_plant_react_ms.notes: How long the title plant reacts to a click or tap.

title_plant_react_cooldown_ms.notes: Shortest gap between two title-plant reactions, so rapid taps do not stack.

title_plant_name_prefixes.notes: First word of an auto-generated display name. Holiday art may want its own list.

title_plant_name_nouns.notes: Second word of an auto-generated display name.

title_hint_fade_ms.notes: How long the hide-UI hint stays bright before it fades to the edge of readable. Title screen only.

title_day_night_seconds.notes: One full day and night on the title screen. The menu runs before a connection exists, so it keeps its own clock; 3600 is an hour.

title_day_night_start_fraction.notes: Where in the cycle the title screen starts. 0 is midnight, 0.25 dawn, 0.5 noon, 0.75 dusk; 0.4 opens in late morning.

title_horizon_fraction.notes: Height of the ground line as a share of the screen. The plant, the hills and the treeline all stand on it, and the menu hangs under it.

vitals_low_fraction.notes: A store at or below this fraction of its capacity is drawn low (amber bar and value). The single vitals readout grades instead of printing numbers only.

vitals_critical_fraction.notes: A store at or below this fraction is drawn critical (red, pulsing). Must stay at or below vitals_low_fraction.

hud_font_small_px.notes: Smallest HUD type in CSS pixels at text scale 1. Below 12px the resource labels and weather line were unreadable on a laptop.

hud_font_secondary_px.notes: Secondary HUD type (clock sub-line, key badges) in CSS pixels at text scale 1.
